operational_learning.text: The deployed /delegate (~/.claude/skills/delegate/SKILL.md) may be older than the aitools working copy (shared/skills/delegate/SKILL.md v2.6), and issue #180 v5.2 is newer than both; where they differ, follow the newest words of the commander (D-DEL6), which are in the issue

A delegate's subagents/agent-<agentId>.meta.json (which links its mission name to its agentId) was created when the delegate finished (20:55:18Z), not at launch; do not rely on it while a delegate runs

ait-harvest.py archive already copies transcripts into the dotprofile and commits and pushes them, detached because Claude Code gives SessionEnd hooks a short window; session-catchup.sh recovers what an abrupt exit cut off. Reuse it for the running-estimate copy
Another session can edit the same working-copy files at the same time (commit 3893c908 staged only its own lines with git update-index); run git log and git diff on a shared file before editing it
The 10-character session id prefix includes the UUID's first hyphen (dbd05b0c-2.db)

The harvester copies every non-ephemeral top-level file of a session scratch directory into the tracked harvesting/; *.json files are ephemeral only when named package-lock*, node_modules*, tsconfig* or *.config.json, so briefs are harvested until RFC 0011 S-14 ships
